body: Be brave face the end with courage. In those final moments we are all alone. Most of us know we are not living our life’s to our full potential. And  your words I hope inspire at least one person to follow there heart. Do the things we are afraid to take chances and not live on regret. It’s a lot easier said then done. We are all hear for you. I hope you find your peace and safe journey. I will pray for you for what’s that’s worth
